title: Evaluation of an embedded circuit
statement: Let $D$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $m$ inputs, let $s$ be a list of $m$ source indices, and let $I$ be a list of Boolean values such that every index in $s$ is less than the length of $I$. Running the embedded gates of $D$ from $I$ yields at position $|I|+|D.	ext{gates}|$ the value of $D$ on the input whose $i$th coordinate is the value of $I$ at the index specified by the $i$th entry of $s$; an out-of-range lookup in this input is interpreted as false.
hypotheses_covered: Every source index is less than the length of the initial list
